region_diagnostics.policy: different region preferred, not a hard construction gate

point_score_parameter_sensitivity.selection_rule: lambda=1 gives one equal evidence point to a correct local fact and its gated remote recovery; cutoff=2 requires two total evidence points, either two local facts or one complete local-to-G chain.

historical_threshold_diagnostic.threshold_status: reported development diagnostic threshold; not frozen for successor
historical_threshold_diagnostic.interpretation: feasibility evidence only when the initial false-positive denominator is small

interpretation.main_finding: With equal point weights, the selected score retains more Member sources than the old chain-threshold rule while rejecting both development True_Non_Member false positives at the selected operational cutoff.
interpretation.score_interpretation: Each correct local fact contributes one point; each correct gated probe of the shared remote target contributes one additional point. The latter is not an independent fact because all probes share G.
interpretation.parameter_status: lambda=1 and cutoff=2 are development-calibrated candidates. They must be frozen before successor victim responses and must not be tuned on formal results.
interpretation.chain_auc_limitation: The historical chain score contains the initial correctness gate and is retained only as an audit comparison.
interpretation.nonmember_interaction: Unestimable because only two True_Non_Member sources triggered a follow-up in this development artifact.
interpretation.next_step: Freeze the point-score rule in a new development identity with correct_anchor and remote_only as core arms; report source-level scores, AUC, FPR/TPR, and the cutoff diagnostic together.
